papers.authors: Bordoloi, P. P.; Mittal, S.; Iyyani, S.
papers.title: From Empirical to Physical Model: Direct Fits of Optically Thin Inverse Compton Scattering to Prompt GRB Spectra
papers.classification: sample-member of the INITIAL 41, then EXCLUDED from the final 4. Not a dedicated analysis; but it makes a specific, testable, TIME-RESOLVED claim about our burst.
papers.what_it_says_about_this_burst: GRB 120905657 satisfies their initial cuts on the GBM catalog time-integrated and peak-flux Band parameters (fluence > 1e-5 erg/cm2; flnc alpha > -0.5; flnc beta in (-1.7,-3.3); pflx alpha > -0.45; pflx beta in (-1.7,-3.3)) - verified independently against the live HEASARC row, all five cuts pass. It was then excluded at the time-resolved stage. Figure 10 caption p.17 verbatim: 'GRB 120905657 / GRB 181227262 / GRB 221206516 ... A few representative GRBs that were excluded from the initial sample because their time-resolved Band alpha and beta did not meet the selection criteria.' Their gate: at least ~80% of Bayesian-Block bins inside the T70 region (15%-85% of cumulative background-subtracted counts) must satisfy alpha > -0.45 AND -1.7 > beta > -3.3.
papers.pdf: Skills_training/Bordoloi_2026_2026ApJ100358B_bn091209001.pdf + _PUB.pdf (and Bordoloi_2026_2026ApJ1003_58B_PUB.pdf, and a _bn090620400 pair). NOT re-downloaded (G2). corpus_index row 131, read=N.

READ: SS2 'Criteria and Sample Selection' p.2 (the cuts, the Bayesian-Block binning on the brightest NaI+BGO, the T70 definition at 15%/85% cumulative counts, the ~80%-of-bins gate) and the Figure 10 caption p.17 (the verdict on our burst). OPTIONAL: SS5.4/SS6 for the physical picture of the four survivors. SKIP: SS3-SS4 (the Naima/3ML optically-thin-IC machinery, applied only to their four survivors - GRB 131014A, GRB 200412B, GRB 200829A, GRB 230614C, none of them ours) unless the IC-model question is on the table. Appendix A is distributions only - the per-burst 41-row table is machine-readable-only and NOT in the PDF.

papers.traps_applied: T5 (their Fig-10 caption says 'excluded from the initial sample' while SS2 and the same page treat the 41 AS the initial sample reduced to four - recorded, we adopt 'excluded from the FINAL sample', flagged not silently resolved). T7 (their alpha/beta gate is a statement about BAND-function parameters, i.e. a selector for quasi-thermal-looking fits, not a claim about a physical component - our diff compares Band alpha/beta to their windows, it does not translate them). finding: A NAMELESS, CIRCULAR-LESS, GBM-ONLY LONG BURST WITH EXACTLY ONE REFEREED MENTION - AND THAT MENTION IS A TESTABLE NEGATIVE. (a) IDENTITY: no letter-suffix designation was ever assigned (two GBM catalogs print the name column blank), no GCN circular exists, no other mission detected it, no LAT/LLE data exist, and there is no redshift or afterglow of any kind - so the module-future reading shelf for this burst is EMPTY and its entire value to the campaign is in the prompt phase. (b) PHYSICS: it is LONG (T90 = 195.6 s, 50-300 keV), moderately bright (fluence 1.96e-5 erg/cm2), SOFT (time-integrated Comptonized Ep = 91.8 +/- 2.8 keV), triggered on the slowest 2048 ms timescale, and - the striking part - almost NON-EVOLVING in Ep: peak-interval Ep = 101.3 +/- 12.9 keV against time-integrated Ep = 91.8 +/- 2.8 keV in the SAME model family, a ratio of 1.10 +/- 0.15 across a 195 s burst. That is the opposite end of the campaign's dynamic range from bn120420858 (7993 vs 363 keV). (c) THE ONE PAPER: Bordoloi+2026 pulled it into their initial 41 on exactly those catalog Band parameters and then threw it out because its TIME-RESOLVED Band alpha and beta failed their quasi-thermal window in more than ~20% of T70 bins - which is a published, falsifiable statement about the very quantity our Step 6 measures, and the archival prior predicts the failing parameter is beta (railing steeper than -3.3), not alpha. (d) STAGE-1 EXPOSURE: our stamped window [-2, +110] s holds only ~81-87% of the 50-300 keV counts of a burst that runs to +188 s, and every approved post-burst background window opens before T95 (n7's opens INSIDE the source window) - an accepted human decision whose magnitude is now on the record.
